title: An architecture comparison was about to be published with the initialisation confounded
symptom: Mamba-YOLO-T at 0.8266 appeared to lose to YOLO11n at 0.8755, which would have reported the AAAI-2025 architecture losing.
root_cause: YOLO11n started from COCO-pretrained weights; the Mamba fork releases none, so it trained from random init. On 3,671 images pretraining is worth about three times the architecture difference.
correction_made: A from-scratch YOLO11n control was run on the same protocol (0.8041 +/- 0.0028), reversing the reading: at equal init Mamba-YOLO-T wins by +0.0225. Both figures carry the confound in figures_data.json so the caveat travels with the data.
